html:
Build scope

What Healthcare Fit-Out includes

A healthcare interior needs clear patient movement, cleanable surfaces and carefully coordinated technical systems.

01Reception and waitingCalm arrival, clear queueing and patient privacy.
02Consultation roomsLayouts tuned to clinical workflow and equipment.
03Diagnostic labsPathology and radiology zones planned by process.
04Hygienic finishesAntibacterial paint, seamless vinyl and coving.
05Clinical lighting5000K shadow-free task lighting.
06Lab HVACNegative-pressure coordination where required.
07Plumbing and wet areasSinks, handwashing and eyewash points.
08Medical storagePurpose-built cabinets and supply systems.

A controlled programme

6 steps from brief to handover

Decisions are approved in sequence so the site team can build with fewer changes and clearer accountability.

01

Survey and clinical brief

Record patient flow, rooms, equipment and utility needs.

02

Clinical design and 3D

Approve the layout, reception, rooms, lighting and finishes.

03

Compliance review

Check hygiene zoning, ventilation, plumbing and fire safety.

04

Construction and MEP

Coordinate partitions, floors, power, plumbing and HVAC.

05

Clinical-grade finishing

Install coving, antibacterial finishes, lighting and joinery.

06

Inspection-ready handover

Snag, clean and prepare the facility for review.

Indicative PKR pricing

A practical range before the survey

These planning figures come from the service scope. The proposal is fixed only after site review and specification approval.

Basic ClinicPKR 6,000–8,000 / sq. ft.
PKR 9M–12M
Mid-Spec ClinicPKR 8,000–10,000 / sq. ft.
PKR 12M–15M
Premium LabPKR 10,000–12,000 / sq. ft.
PKR 15M–18M

Examples use a 1,500 sq. ft. unit. Final cost depends on room types, technical systems, joinery and specification.

Practical answers

Healthcare Fit-Out FAQs

Six short answers about scope, timing and cost.

A typical 1,500 sq. ft. clinic or lab ranges from PKR 9M to 18M, depending on rooms and technical systems.

A private clinic takes about 5–7 weeks. A diagnostic lab often takes 7–10 weeks.

It needs hygienic finishes, clinical lighting, controlled ventilation and specialist plumbing planned from the start.

Yes. We coordinate controlled airflow, seamless surfaces, lab plumbing, lighting, equipment positions and storage.

Fit-out builds a new shell into an operational facility. Renovation upgrades a healthcare space already in use.

Yes. Woodex Furniture™ manufactures reception desks, lab cabinetry, consultation joinery and medical storage.
